fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
The nurse is told of a severe allergy at once

Priya Halvorsen's form at Kestrel Ridge Middle School lists a severe peanut allergy and an epinephrine auto-injector kept in the nurse's office. Nurse Colette Amari gets an in-app alert when the form comes in, and Priya joins the grade 7 allergy list.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { newEnrollment: "Build a new student information form for Birch Hollow Elementary. Parents enter the student's name, grade, date of birth, and home address, plus 2 emergency contacts in calling order. Add directory opt-out checkboxes for photograph, address, and telephone listing, and show a Photo opt-out flag on the student's row in the roster the yearbook office uses.", addressChanges: "Build a change of information form for families at Birch Hollow Elementary. A parent picks their child, enters the new address and the date of the move, and submits. Update the student's row with the new address, keep the old address below it with the date it changed, and email the front office with both addresses.", schoolNurses: "Build the health section of the student information form for Kestrel Ridge Middle School. A yes to any allergy opens questions on the trigger, the severity, and any medication kept at school. When an allergy is marked severe, send the school nurse an in-app alert and add the student to an allergy list for their grade.", collegeRegistrars: "Build a release form for students at Fenwick State College. The student names the records to release, the purpose, and the person who may receive them, then signs on screen. Save each signed release to the student's record and show the registrar a queue of releases marked Signed or Waiting." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Pick the answers that need a person to act, and a channel for each. A new address can email the front office, a severe allergy can alert the nurse in the app, and a counselor can get a Slack message.
fieldData.afb---prompt: Build a student information form that saves every response to a database I own.

acrm---key-feature-3-image.alt: Priya Halvorsen's health section lists a severe peanut allergy and an auto-injector kept at school, and nurse Colette Amari gets an alert as Priya joins the grade 7 allergy list.
